text:
Maya: Quick poll — who’s doing something this weekend? There’s a wood-fired pizza pop-up Saturday around 5pm, or a ramen crawl Sunday 1pm. Thoughts?
Jordan: Pizza pop-up sounds great. :pizza: where is it?
Maya: It’s at the community lot by 3rd & Pine — popup called Ember & Loaf. Venue notes said bring a blanket/chairs. `45 Pine St (lot)`
Noah: Ramen crawl sounds dangerous (in a fun way) but I can only do Sat evening.
Priya: I’m team ramen but only Sunday works for me. Any kids/plus-ones?
Sam: I can drive Sat, I have 2 spare seats. Carpool? :minibus:
Jordan: I’ll take a seat Sam, thanks!
Maya: Cool — looks like more votes for pizza if we count Sat folks. But ramen has a passionate fan club.
Priya: If we do pizza I can bring a portable table and some plates. Also happy to join ramen Sunday if others want split crews.
Noah: If we split, maybe pizza Saturday meetup at 5, ramen Sunday noon for whoever’s free. Works?
Jordan: Works for me. Saturday for pizza — I’ll bring a small bluetooth speaker for ambience (low volume promise).
Maya: Love it. Meetup: Sat 5pm at `Ember & Loaf` lot. If you need a ride, ping Sam.
Sam: I’ll post pickup spots in a sec. Leaving from SoMa at 4:30pm, can swing by Mission at 4:45.
Priya: Can someone save a vegetarian slice for me? :pray:
Noah: Veg slice saved, Priya. :grin:
lunch-bot: Poll update — 6 confirm for Saturday pizza, 4 interest in Sunday ramen.
Maya: Awesome. See you Saturday folks!
Jordan: See ya! :wave:
